**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant. I checked:

- **sec-5.4** (the planner's candidate) — appoints a General Manager liaison for each Party but imposes no restriction on hiring the other Party's people.
- Full-text searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce", "personnel", "directly or indirectly" — no hits indicating a personnel restriction (only incidental uses in the confidentiality carve-outs and the no-joint-venture clause).
- Confidentiality (§8), Warranties (§9) and General Provisions (§10) — nothing on personnel.

This sits at the **preferred** position: no non-solicit binds the Company. The only restrictive covenants are the Section 6 exclusivity provisions (§6.1 binding the Company as to competing Deerskin-branded web projects), which are a distinct commercial term handled under the exclusivity rule and not double-flagged here.
